narration: You were born into a military family with a long history of service. Your parents, Thrain and Elara Ashfall, were both veterans of a long and brutal war. They met while serving in the same unit and settled down after the war, passing on their values of duty, honor, and loyalty to you. As a child, you listened to their stories of battles fought and won, and of the camaraderie that formed between soldiers. Their experiences shaped your desire to follow in their footsteps and make a name for yourself as a warrior.
